name: CommScope Connectivity and Cable Solutions

source.quote: Anticipates CCS will generate sales and EBITDA margins of approximately $3.6 billion and 26% in 2025, respectively

description: Fiber and copper cabling and connectivity business sold by CommScope to Amphenol in January 2026.
explain: This business makes the fiber cabling used inside data centers. Amphenol paid CommScope $10.5 billion for it.
